VERSION 3.24.0.149

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/Toolbar.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope
        REPLACE penThicknessSelected WITH {
            signal penThicknessSelected(thickness : var)
        }
        REPLACE eraserThicknessSelected WITH {
            signal eraserThicknessSelected(thickness : var)
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/common/Values.qml
    IMPORT xofm.libs.toolbar 1.0
    TRAVERSE Item
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            property var mPenThicknessModel: {
                const iterable = [
                    {
                        iconPath: 'qrc:/ark/icons/stroke_thin',
                        thickness: 0.5,
                        displayName: 'Thinner',
                    },
                    {
                        iconPath: 'qrc:/ark/icons/stroke_thin',
                        thickness: 1,
                        displayName: 'Thin',
                    },
                    {
                        iconPath: 'qrc:/ark/icons/stroke_medium',
                        thickness: 1.5,
                        displayName: 'Medium Thin',
                    },
                    {
                        iconPath: 'qrc:/ark/icons/stroke_medium',
                        thickness: 2,
                        displayName: 'Medium',
                    },
                    {
                        iconPath: 'qrc:/ark/icons/stroke_medium',
                        thickness: 2.5,
                        displayName: 'Medium Thick',
                    },
                    {
                        iconPath: 'qrc:/ark/icons/stroke_thick',
                        thickness: 3,
                        displayName: 'Thick',
                    },
                    {
                        iconPath: 'qrc:/ark/icons/stroke_thick',
                        thickness: 5,
                        displayName: 'Thicker',
                    },
                    {
                        iconPath: 'qrc:/ark/icons/stroke_thick',
                        thickness: 8,
                        displayName: 'Even Thicker',
                    },
                ];
                iterable.isValidThickness = () => true;
                iterable.nameForThickness = e => iterable.find(z => z.thickness === e)?.displayName ?? '';
                iterable.iconForThickness = e => iterable.find(z => z.thickness === e)?.iconPath ?? '';
                iterable.thicknessAt = e => iterable[e].thickness;
                iterable.defaultThickness = () => iterable[1];
                return iterable;
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/WritingTool.qml
    IMPORT common 1.0
    TRAVERSE PenTool
        REMOVE PenThicknessModel
        REPLACE penThicknessSelected WITH {
            signal penThicknessSelected(thickness : var)
        }
        TRAVERSE ArkControls.FoldoutGrid > Repeater[.model=thicknessModel] > ArkControls.FoldoutItem
            REPLACE thickness WITH { required property var thickness }
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
    REBUILD PenTool
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        REPLACE { thicknessModel } WITH STREAM /Values.mPenThicknessModel/
    END REBUILD
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/EraserMenu.qml
    IMPORT common 1.0
    TRAVERSE PenTool
        REMOVE PenThicknessModel
        REPLACE eraserThicknessSelected WITH {
            signal eraserThicknessSelected(thickness : var)
        }
        TRAVERSE ColumnLayout > ArkControls.FoldoutGrid > Repeater[.model=thicknessModel] > ArkControls.FoldoutItem
            REPLACE thickness WITH { required property var thickness }
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
    REBUILD PenTool
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        REPLACE { thicknessModel } WITH STREAM /Values.mPenThicknessModel/
    END REBUILD
END AFFECT
